title: Track restart-required per output component instead of only globally
why: UiStatus's docstring already reserves a restart_required value, but only a single global _restart_required flag exists today (mediainfo/configui/output.py), flipped by any outputs.* edit - a user editing one output has no way to tell which specific display actually needs restarting.
what: Extend restart tracking from ConfigStore.save_form's single global flag to record which specific outputs.* config paths changed since the last restart, then thread that through to UiComponent.status.

title: Surface per-output restart-required badge on Displays cards
why: Once 001 tracks restart-required per component, the Displays card grid should show it on the specific changed output instead of only the Dashboard's blanket Restart button.
what: Add a restart_required badge/status rendering path in components.js's cardTile()/componentCard(), keyed off the per-component signal from 001.

title: Update Help tab restart copy to match per-output behavior
why: The Help tab's Restarts card currently states a blanket any-output-needs-restart rule; once per-card badges exist (002) it should point users at those instead.
what: Revise the static Restarts card text in dashboard.js's renderHelpSection().

title: Add test coverage for per-output restart tracking
why: Per-output restart tracking changes ConfigStore.save_form's return contract and UiComponent.status, both already covered by existing tests that need updating alongside 001.
what: Extend tests/test_config_ui.py and tests/test_ui_model.py to cover per-output-type restart_required values instead of only the global flag.
